role: Existing standards packaging owner; not proof of SEN/SEAVT/ActivityPub++ normative source custody

methodInterpretation.permittedPreparation: Exact historical source paths with byte-verified retained copies can ground a review draft. No current-canonical-source prerequisite is stated in this method.
actualConditions: Name the unique-and-rich-enough judgment and its evidence in the tracking work order demand
Read and list exact corpus paths before composition
Preserve source epistemic status; cite every normative-content section
Hold local draft under the node's content/documents/specifications tree as DRAFT-FOR-LEADER-REVIEW
Mint one LMT class-define work order against draft path; acceptance disposition remains separate
knownMissing: No actual LMT tracking work order for this specifications delivery is verified
No current normative-custody transfer or publication destination for the original SEN/SEAVT/AP++ sources is verified
forbiddenWithoutDisposition: Any representation of draft as accepted

quotes.step2: Every corpus path the token actually lives at — notes, glossary terms, running code, prior work orders — is read and listed by exact path before composition starts. A source that cannot be pointed at by path is not cited.
quotes.step3: No section states a claim its cited sources do not support; a thesis-grade source stays thesis-grade in the draft.
quotes.step4: The draft is saved under this node's own content/documents/specifications/ tree, marked DRAFT-FOR-LEADER-REVIEW in its front matter and body. It is not published, not pushed to GitHub, and not represented anywhere as accepted.
quotes.step5: One LMT work order of class define is minted against the draft's path.
